title: Clinic exam room (16:9)

Here: the key is soft daylight through the half-open blind on the left-hand wall (the window faces west), falling in soft bands across the treatment table; the fill is the flat cool overhead panel, a quarter as strong; the rim is the window light edging the stool and the knee model.
